summary: This is the week the account went quiet and the money stopped. Twelve messages in seven days - down from 163 - and five of them were ours. Vivek, who sent 60 messages last week, sent two: 'Just tested something' (Aug 25, 23:50) and 'Still in review' (Aug 26). He did not answer her direct question 'Did it work!????'. The Facebook 'not recommended' flag is now 335 days old and 21 days into his escalation, and she had to open the week by chasing him again after four days of silence - 'Hey, @fonta' / 'How we looking???' / '👀'. Derrek has now not posted on this account since Aug 13; his own instruction to report back and retry the login is 15 days unanswered and she has stopped asking. The 'Lauryn chat team' vendor group has not posted in 79 days - there was again not one word about chatting, revenue or content. Meanwhile the Aug 15 invoice went late. Stephski sent nothing for eleven days after issuing it, then escalated twice on Aug 26: 'We need to hear back from you as we are multiple invoices unpaid, we know you got us just need verbal confirmation please'. Lauryn replied inside 13 hours, warm as always ('Great morning Stephanie'), and gave the single most important sentence of the week: 'Being that account is basically at a stand still when everything drops I’ll make those invoices expeditiously'. That is the client, for the first time in twelve months of payment history, explicitly linking her payment to our non-performance. She followed it with 'only moving off what’s being funneled'. Nothing is being funneled - nobody has chatted her page in 79 days. The bill and the service failure are now the same problem.

health.rationale: Down 15 from 55, the sharpest single-week drop on this account, and the drop is not about tone - she remains warm and cooperative throughout. Three things happened at once. (1) Delivery stopped: 12 messages in the window against 163 last week, with Vivek down from 60 messages to 2 and no answer to her direct 'Did it work!????'; the 335-day 'not recommended' complaint is unchanged and the only status she got in seven days was 'Still in review'. (2) Last week's predicted financial risk materialised: the Aug 15 invoice passed the 7-day terms on Aug 22 and is now 13 days out and unpaid, after Stephski went 11 days without a single follow-up and then had to write 'we are multiple invoices unpaid'. (3) The client connected the two herself. 'Being that account is basically at a stand still when everything drops I’ll make those invoices expeditiously' (Aug 27) is a soft, polite, dateless payment refusal justified by our own service gap - and it is defensible, because the vendor chat team has been silent 79 days and Derrek 15. The only things holding the score off the 30s are that she has not disputed the amount, she answered the escalation within 13 hours, Michelle's DMCA update landed on schedule for the fifth straight week, and there was no fourth credential ask.

Client tone remains warm and non-hostile despite a week in which she received almost nothing. There is still no relationship damage to repair - only delivery.
